description:
Job Family : 
Scientific Research & Analysis 
 Travel Required : 
None 
 Clearance Required : 
Ability to Obtain Public Trust 
 
 We are currently searching for a Research Scientist to provide support to the National Institutes of Health (NIH) for a short-term engagement expected through March 2027.  

 What You Will Do : 
 Support laboratory research focused on scavenger receptors, high-density lipoprotein (HDL) binding, lipid metabolism, infection, inflammation, and atherosclerosis using animal models and related experimental systems.
 Plan, design, execute, and analyze research experiments that advance laboratory methods, protocols, and scientific discovery.
 Perform hands-on laboratory techniques, including cell culture, competition binding experiments, RNA/DNA extraction, reverse transcription polymerase chain reaction (RT-PCR), radiotracer and fluorescent probe labeling, radioimmunoassay, enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA), fluorescent cellular uptake studies, and isolation of lipid particles and apolipoproteins.
 Analyze, interpret, and manage scientific data; maintain electronic laboratory notebooks and experiment databases.
 Prepare protocols, technical reports, abstracts, posters, manuscripts, presentations, and other scientific work products.
 Present research findings in laboratory meetings, scientific meetings, and other professional forums.
 Maintain, calibrate, and troubleshoot laboratory instruments and equipment; train staff on proper equipment use and research methods.
 Manage reagents, frozen cell stocks, animal samples, supplies, and other laboratory resources; coordinate supply purchases and maintenance needs for Government approval.
 Support laboratory readiness, organization, cleanliness, and compliance with established procedures.
 Mentor junior scientists, fellows, technicians, and other laboratory staff in research techniques, instrumentation, data analysis, and protocol execution.
 
 What You Will Need : 
 Ph.D. degree with a minimum of four (4) years of research experience
 Demonstrated experience with cell culture techniques, DNA/RNA extraction, ELISA, and scavenger receptors required.
 Experience translating scientific and clinical data into publications, presenting findings at scientific forums, and supporting training.
 Must be able to obtain and maintain a Federal or DoD “public trust”; candidates must receive approved adjudication prior to onboarding with Guidehouse. Candidates with an active public trust or suitability are preferred.
 Incumbent capture – no other candidates were considered due to an identified incumbent who meets the labor category requirements provided by the customer
 
 What Would Be Nice To Have : 
 Preferred fields of study: Biology, Biological Science, or related scientific discipline.
 Excellent analytical, organizational, and time management skills
 Experience working in a clinical or federal research setting, preferred.
 
 
The annual salary range for this position is $98,000.00-$163,000.00. Compensation decisions depend on a wide range of factors, including but not limited to skill sets, experience and training, security clearances, licensure and certifications, and other business and organizational needs. 
 What We Offer: 
 Guidehouse offers a comprehensive, total rewards package that includes competitive compensation and a flexible benefits package that reflects our commitment to creating a diverse and supportive workplace.
 
 Benefits include:
 Medical, Rx, Dental & Vision Insurance

 Personal and Family Sick Time & Company Paid Holidays

 Parental Leave

 401(k) Retirement Plan

 Group Term Life and Travel Assistance

 Voluntary Life and AD&D Insurance

 Health Savings Account, Health Care & Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts

 Transit and Parking Commuter Benefits

 Short-Term & Long-Term Disability

 Tuition Reimbursement, Personal Development, Certifications & Learning Opportunities

 Employee Referral Program

 Corporate Sponsored Events & Community Outreach

 Care.com annual membership

 Employee Assistance Program

 Supplemental Benefits via Corestream (Critical Care, Hospital Indemnity, Accident Insurance, Legal Assistance and ID theft protection, etc.)

 Position may be eligible for a discretionary variable incentive bonus
